none: PAS CAM-68F1A1: Roman Coin : Copper alloy Radiate of Tacitus, AD 275 - 276.
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ LAETITIA FVND ; D/ IMP C M CL TACITVS AVG

Copper alloy Radiate of Tacitus, AD 275 - 276 (Reece period 14). Reverse legend reads: LAETITIA FVND. Reverse shows Laetitia standing left, holding wreath and anchor. Mint: Rome. See RIC V, Part 1, p.335, no.89. Obverse legend reads: IMP C M CL TACITVS AVG. Obverse shows Radiate bust facing right. Fine condition. Die axis: 6 o'clock. Weight is 3.57g, diameter is 22.47mm
